title: Pin and scope hosted evidence
responsibility: Bind authorized evidence reads to a project, branch and immutable notes/evidence revisions.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceContext.deps
inputs.description: A dependency bundle with the collaboration API, source history adapter, and cache. hubEvidenceContext uses the API for the project lookup and puts the source adapter and cache in the source context.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceContext.actor
inputs.description: The authenticated collaboration actor passed to the project lookup; its id is copied to the source identity as the reading principal.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceContext.query
inputs.description: Identifies the optional hosted project, entity, branch, commit, and view mode; current-mode reads require the selected commit to equal the branch tip, while commit mode may address a reachable historical commit.

inputs.name: hubEvidencePins.base
inputs.description: A source context carrying the adapter, repository, resolved commit, tree entries, cache, and cache identity. Pin operations use its repository and identity to validate and bind hosted evidence revisions.

inputs.name: hubEvidencePins.query
inputs.description: The requested hosted notes and evidence revisions, each a commit string or null. A changed pin is accepted only when both the existing and requested revisions are present and the requested revision is reachable from the existing one.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceScope.base
inputs.description: A source context carrying the adapter, repository, resolved commit, tree entries, cache, and cache identity. Scope reads use its repository and pinned identity to justify the requested evidence view.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceScope.query
inputs.description: Identifies the optional project, entity, branch, commit, and view mode. The commit must be reachable from tip, and current mode additionally requires it to equal tip.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceScope.tip
inputs.description: The selected branch tip used as the reachability boundary and for current-mode validation.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceContext
outputs.type: Promise<{ base: HubSourceContext; tip: string; repository: RepositoryIdentity; }>
outputs.description: Resolves to { base, tip, repository } after loading the selected project and resolving its requested commit. It refuses a missing project id, a missing branch tip, or a current-mode commit that differs from the tip.

outputs.name: hubEvidencePins
outputs.description: Resolves to undefined after checking both requested revisions. Changed pins must be present and reachable from their current pins; on success, base.identity is replaced with the requested revisions.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceScope
outputs.type: Promise<{ scope: ExplorerScope; revisions: { head: HarnessRevision; parent: HarnessRevision | null; }; history: HubRecordStatusService; }>
outputs.description: Resolves to { scope, revisions, history } for a registered entity and a commit reachable from tip. revisions.parent is the exact first-parent detail or null, and history reads records under the pinned notes and evidence revisions.

errors.name: forbidden
errors.description: Thrown when hubEvidenceContext receives a query without projectId before the project lookup.

errors.name: evidence-stale
errors.description: Thrown when a current-mode query names a commit other than the selected branch tip, or when a changed notes/evidence pin is absent or cannot be reached from its current pin.

errors.name: evidence-unreadable
errors.description: Thrown when the selected branch has no tip, a requested commit cannot be proven reachable from the tip, commit facts are missing or disagree with the requested commit, or the entity has no registered kind.

errors.name: Invalid current-tip scope or unsupported entity kind
errors.description: The scope helper calls recordedScope, which throws a plain Error if a current-mode commit differs from tip or if its kind has no mapped explorer category.
